method: Target propagated from SIMBAD J2000 with astropy apply_space_motion to MJD-AVG (no annual parallax, no binary orbit). Wavelength from spectral WCS key W at that pixel. Status: not_covered if the predicted position is outside the cutout; flagged if any non-informational flag bit or non-finite pixel lies in the aperture; else clear.
limitations: A clear status is a screening result, not a detection, calibrated flux or astrometric validation.
Annual parallax is not applied; for Barnard's Star, Eps Ind B and WISE 0855 it shifts the apparent position by up to ~0.55, 0.27 and 0.44 arcsec (<0.1 px).
Eps Ind B is a binary brown dwarf (Ba/Bb) unresolved at ~6 arcsec pixels; orbital motion is ignored.
